cases.text:
happy: Pay by saved card
Steps: Add an item to the cart | Choose the saved card | Confirm payment
Expected: The order is placed and a receipt is shown

negative: Card is declined at checkout
Steps: Add an item to the cart | Enter a card the bank declines | Confirm payment
Expected: An error is shown and no order is created

edge: Payment page is submitted twice
Steps: Open checkout | Press pay twice quickly
Expected: The customer is charged once

happy: Apply a valid coupon
Steps: Open the cart | Enter a current coupon code | Press apply
Expected: The total goes down by the coupon amount

negative: Apply an expired coupon
Steps: Open the cart | Enter an expired coupon code | Press apply
Expected: A message says the coupon has expired and the total stays the same

happy: Return a delivered order
Steps: Open a delivered order | Choose return | Pick a reason and submit
Expected: A return request is created and a pickup date is shown

edge: Return after the return window
Steps: Open an order delivered 40 days ago | Choose return
Expected: The return option is not available and the policy is explained

happy: Search finds a product by name
Steps: Type a product name in search | Press enter
Expected: Matching products are listed

edge: Search with no results
Steps: Type random letters in search | Press enter
Expected: An empty state suggests other categories

happy: Add a new delivery address
Steps: Open account | Add an address with a valid pincode | Save
Expected: The address appears in the saved list

negative: Delivery address with a wrong pincode
Steps: Open account | Enter a five digit pincode | Save
Expected: The form shows a pincode error and nothing is saved

edge: Item goes out of stock while in the cart
Steps: Add the last unit to the cart | Another customer buys it | Open checkout
Expected: The cart warns that the item is no longer available

happy: Book an appointment with a doctor
Steps: Choose a doctor | Pick a free slot | Confirm
Expected: The slot is booked and a confirmation is sent

edge: Two patients book the same slot
Steps: Open one slot in two sessions | Confirm both
Expected: One booking succeeds and the other is asked to pick a new slot

negative: Book a slot in the past
Steps: Choose yesterday's date | Pick a slot
Expected: The date cannot be selected

happy: Patient cancels an appointment
Steps: Open the appointment | Press cancel | Confirm
Expected: The slot is free again and the patient is told

happy: Add a prescription after a visit
Steps: Open the visit | Add a medicine with dose and days | Save
Expected: The prescription is on the patient record

negative: Prescription without a dose
Steps: Open the visit | Add a medicine and leave the dose empty | Save
Expected: The form asks for a dose

happy: Upload a lab report
Steps: Open a patient | Upload a PDF report
Expected: The report is listed with its date

negative: Upload a file that is too large
Steps: Open a patient | Upload a 50 MB file
Expected: An error gives the size limit and nothing is stored

negative: Receptionist opens a medical record
Steps: Sign in as a receptionist | Open a patient's record
Expected: Access is denied

happy: Doctor signs in
Steps: Enter a doctor's email and password | Press sign in
Expected: The doctor's schedule opens

queries.text:
Checkout payment
Customers pay for their cart with a credit or debit card

Discount codes
A shopper can redeem a promo code to reduce the order total

Refunds and returns
Customers can send back something they bought

Product search
Find items in the catalogue using a text box

Shipping details
Manage where orders are delivered

Inventory limits
Handle products that run out before the purchase finishes

Appointment scheduling
Patients reserve time with a doctor

Cancelling a visit
Let a patient give up a booking they no longer need

Medicine orders
Doctors record what a patient should take and how much

Lab results
Attach test documents to a patient

Staff permissions
Only the right roles can see private patient data

Login
Staff enter their credentials to reach the app

Employee payroll
HR runs monthly salary slips and tax deductions

Fleet tracking
Drivers report truck location from a mobile device

Video game leaderboard
Players compare high scores with friends

Invoice export for accountants
Download a yearly ledger as a spreadsheet
